import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

root = ET.fromstring(xml_data)
# Namespace
ns = {'u': 'http://uniprot.org/uniprot'}
for feat in root.findall('u:feature', ns):
    f_type = feat.attrib.get('type')
    desc = feat.attrib.get('description', '')
    loc = feat.find('u:location', ns)
    begin = loc.find('u:begin', ns) if loc is not None else None
    end = loc.find('u:end', ns) if loc is not None else None
    pos = loc.find('u:position', ns) if loc is not None else None
    if begin is not None and end is not None:
        print(f_type, desc, begin.attrib.get('position'), end.attrib.get('position'))
    elif pos is not None:
        print(f_type, desc, pos.attrib.get('position'))
    else:
        print(f_type, desc, loc)
